Sign.name: Sign
Sign.definition: Indicates that the amount value is positive or negative.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Description of the balance amount that may be provided to the customer (for example ‘Available’, ‘Ledger’). If this element is not included in a Balance <Bal> it is assumed the balance is a ‘ledger’ balance.Date of the amount.
